# Plutus Crypto

> Crypto payment gateway for businesses in most of the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom: accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Solana and the stablecoins USDT and USDC, and get paid in euros, pounds or dollars.

Plutus Crypto charges three percent per transaction, everything included (conversion, blockchain network fees and settlement); there is no monthly fee, no setup fee and no chargeback fee, with a better rate above one million per month. The rate is locked for 15 minutes when the customer opens the payment and stays locked while the payment confirms. Confirmed payments settle to the merchant's bank account the next business day by SEPA or Faster Payments. Ways to take payments: payment links, a hosted checkout, a drop in widget, an in store terminal, payouts and refunds, recurring billing, and plugins for WooCommerce, Magento 2, PrestaShop, OpenCart, Drupal Commerce and Shopware; developers get a REST API with signed webhooks and SDKs for Node, Python, PHP, Ruby and Go. Opening an account means a business verification that takes a few days. The demo and dashboard on the website are a sandbox simulation. Contact: info@plutuscrypto.com, reply within one business day.

## Main pages
- [Crypto Payment Gateway for Business](https://plutuscrypto.com/): Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Solana and stablecoins online, in store or by link. Rate locked at payment, paid to your bank next business day, 3% all in.
- [About Plutus](https://plutuscrypto.com/about/): Plutus was the Greek god of wealth, blinded so he would give without prejudice. Our payment network works the same for any chain, wallet or country.
- [Contact](https://plutuscrypto.com/contact/): Tell us what you sell and where. We reply within one business day with the account structure, the rate and the integration route that fits.
- [Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum and Stablecoins](https://plutuscrypto.com/currencies/): How to accept Bitcoin as a business, step by step, plus every coin and stablecoin we take, the confirmations we wait for and how long each one takes.
- [How to accept Bitcoin payments](https://plutuscrypto.com/currencies/#accept-bitcoin): six steps from first contact to the first bank payout, plus Bitcoin facts on confirmations, refunds and VAT with sources
- [Live Crypto Checkout Demo](https://plutuscrypto.com/demo/): A working crypto checkout in your browser. Create a payment as the merchant, pay it as the customer, scan a real QR code, and watch it land in the dashboard.
- [Crypto Payment API and Webhooks](https://plutuscrypto.com/developers/): A REST API with signed webhooks, idempotency keys and a sandbox that mirrors production. SDKs for Node, Python, PHP, Ruby and Go, plus shop plugins.
- [Crypto Payments FAQ for Merchants](https://plutuscrypto.com/faq/): Straight answers for merchants about cost, payments, settlement, compliance and integration when you accept crypto with Plutus Crypto.
- [Pricing: 3% per Crypto Payment, All In](https://plutuscrypto.com/pricing/): Three percent per transaction, everything included. No monthly fee, no setup fee, no chargeback fee. Add your own surcharge and turn crypto into a margin.
- [Privacy](https://plutuscrypto.com/privacy/): What this website collects, what it does with it, and what it does not do.
- [Crypto Checkout, Payment Links and POS](https://plutuscrypto.com/product/): Hosted checkout, drop in widget, payment links, in store terminal, payouts, refunds and recurring billing. One account for every way to get paid in crypto.
- [Security and compliance](https://plutuscrypto.com/security/): Every incoming transaction screened, blockchain finality instead of chargebacks, no card data in scope, signed webhooks, roles, two factor and an audit trail.
- [Crypto Payments by Industry](https://plutuscrypto.com/solutions/): Where crypto payments earn their place: ecommerce, gaming, travel, luxury retail, trading, remittances, B2B trade and marketplaces.
- [Crypto Payments for B2B Invoices](https://plutuscrypto.com/solutions/b2b/): Cross-border invoices paid by wire arrive late, short of fees and need matching by hand. A crypto payment link on the invoice solves all three at once.
- [Accept Crypto in Your Online Shop](https://plutuscrypto.com/solutions/ecommerce/): Crypto buyers spend more per order and never charge back. For a shop selling anything above a hundred euros, that is a margin line, not a curiosity.
- [Crypto Payments for Gaming and iGaming](https://plutuscrypto.com/solutions/gaming/): Players want to deposit now and withdraw tonight from anywhere. Cards decline, banks are slow and disputes eat margin. Crypto works the way players expect.
- [Crypto Payments for Luxury Retail](https://plutuscrypto.com/solutions/luxury/): A watch, jewellery, a car: the buyer can pay but the card stops at five thousand. Crypto has no card limit, clears in minutes and cannot be charged back.
- [Crypto Payments for Marketplaces](https://plutuscrypto.com/solutions/marketplaces/): A buyer pays once. The platform keeps its commission and pays one or several sellers the way each prefers. Split incoming payments and pay out in crypto.
- [Stablecoin Remittances Across Borders](https://plutuscrypto.com/solutions/remittances/): Some corridors are slow, some expensive and some closed to correspondent banking. Stablecoins move a euro's worth of value across any of them in under a minute.
- [Crypto Deposits for Trading and FX](https://plutuscrypto.com/solutions/trading/): Clients fund accounts from a wallet and withdraw to one, while your ledger, auditor and regulator want one reporting currency. You can have both at once.
- [Crypto Payments for Travel Businesses](https://plutuscrypto.com/solutions/travel/): A traveller books a room abroad and pays in a third currency. Cards decline and FX fees hide in the rate. Crypto payments reach your bank next business day.
- [Website terms](https://plutuscrypto.com/terms/): The terms that apply to using plutuscrypto.com and its demo. The payment service itself is governed by the merchant agreement signed at onboarding.
